method: Four shirt-only patches; half-resolution zero-mean normalized cross correlation by FFT directly to frame 10; subpixel parabola; robust similarity fit from cross-body patch pairs; no accumulation drift
transform_formula: q = pivot + translation + scale * rotation_clockwise_in_screen_coordinates * (p - pivot)
smoothing: Nine-frame symmetric Gaussian sigma=2 frames; only short rejected gaps interpolated; reference rebased to identity; no output when acceptance fails
limits: Shirt is nonrigid; local texture motion may not support a single global torso transform.
Does not track or alter the head, face, neck, source video, or narration.
No new gesture is inferred from missing shoulders.
Candidate transform needs an independent moving composite review.

reference_space_mapping.application: A new wrapper outside existing #shirt-clip; preserve nested scaleY(1.14). Translate relative to this pivot, then rotate/scale about it. Do not also add css_matrix when using decomposed properties.
reference_space_mapping.transform_order: translate(x,y) rotate(rotation) scale(scale) with transform-origin at pivot_reference_px
